features.name: Life A walk (slice 6): pay every 2 weeks from setup to three months on: a line each pay, a yearly cost and its nudge, pay day in two steps, the pay changed to monthly with its line asked about, hand-worked figures at every step
Pay day in two steps (slice 6, G4): when the pay covers what leaves that day, Home shows the pay and each item as their own steps to the bank at the end of the day; safe to spend unchanged

Plan names every rhythm in words from one function (slice 6): a day or two days each month, every n weeks on its weekday, every few months, set months, once a year, once, the last working day, no fixed day

Life C walk (slice 6): no fixed pay from setup to three months on: money in from Receipts, due in the next 30 days, a line each month by the day, lasts about N weeks, hand-worked figures at every step
Receipts Money in (slice 6): a client payment or a gift into one of your own accounts, never a card; listed as Money in, changed in place, kept through a reload

Setup for the other lives (slice 6): the country chosen, a second bank, cash and e-wallets, pay on a day, two days, every n weeks or no fixed pay, a second income on its own day and account, cards and bills from their own account, bills once a year
The made-up Mako book behind ?try=mako (his shape, ids like the app's, nothing written)
Home top: bank today and its age, safe to spend with its sum, next pay, due before next pay, each card and when it comes out beside the pay
Check your bank: ticked list with editable amounts, the bank figure, Home updates; kept by the store (IndexedDB burrow3) through reload and restart; old copies untouched
Check your bank asks what is on each card now (optional, blank is not checked), written as a check on the card: Home's card owed, due before next pay and safe to spend follow it

Home words the engine's warnings from their data (account, amount, day, minimum or none): below zero with no minimum, its minimum named when there is one, days and months as VOICE, never the engine's text or a raw ISO day
Home's bank today in its parts from the engine once something is logged after the check: the check and its day, what went out and came in since
A line or Free to spend started mid-period shows one amount for the period, the part that counts now, with the full amount in a sentence; a line gone over says by how much, taken from safe to spend
A card whose payment is past its day and not ticked names that payment on Home's card line, never Nothing to pay yet
The try book with the engine check-in writer: a check-in on 10 Dec, and the weekend where card B leaves before pay

Every amount box (Receipts log and Change this, Check your bank, every Plan form, Setup) goes through screens/inputs.js: a tap, click or Tab, or a form's own focus then a click, selects the old value so typing replaces it
No money maths in screens
Idle CPU, long tasks, no outside requests, no errors
Opens offline
Period dates on Home and the next pay state (res.period)
act3, the one write door: named actions with ids, told, at, by; remove and Undo by gone marks; Undo keeps later changes
Cloud copy core: code to key under its own id (E3), only ciphertext sent, two devices join, same record changed on both asked and kept (AW7), refused write joined again (AW5), newer shape refused
Statements read: rows with posting dates, card statements, Japanese dates and files, the pasted-answer checker

Statements written: imp: lines with posting dates, matched to typed spends and expected items by the frozen rules (engine/match.js), card payments once, card statements as statement records, BC4 lines, duplicates once

Receipts: log a spend fast (amount, line or place, account or card, day, note), a refund, money moved; list by period with search; change and remove with Undo; Free to spend left and safe to spend before and after, from the engine

Only the tapped tab's panel shows: every tab after every other tab, Settings, Reminders and Ask opened and closed over each tab, Check your bank left by a tab tap (one tab switch in start3.js, one [hidden] rule)
One figure, one name: on Home, Receipts and Plan every figure the name table knows sits under its label from screens/names.js, and no heading uses another name for a money figure

The first screen's I already use the burrow on another device opens the cloud code box with Restore from a file beside it. Out of the made-up numbers: the try band's Set up with my own numbers drops the try book (nothing written) and opens setup, or shows the book this device already keeps
Plan steps through act3: budget lines, Free to spend, bills from a date, goals in the bank or their own account, loans, card days (pure)

Add statements on the page: choose files per account, read with the AI (relay or the viewer's Claude) or any AI pasted and checked, review (what was read, card statements, shops with categories, tap for lines and what each meets), Add through act3 with Undo, honest privacy lines (E7)
Each record once after a statement (BI2): Receipts and past periods count through the engine's countOnce, a bank line to your own account is the move

Plan tab: this pay period with each line and Free to spend left, bills with their days (add, change from a date, end), goals in the bank or their own account with money set aside, cards and loans with their payment days, pay periods gone by from what happened
Backup file: save (optional code, own salt), read directly, newer shape and old app refused
Settings: currency, storage line, save a backup, restore from a file after asking with the copy here kept whole first, Put it back, a backup as the way in

Two tabs: a save in one shows in the other without a reload; a save refused as behind catches up and saves the same step again; the same record changed in both says Changed in another tab, shows it again and keeps the draft

Private publish: publish3.sh writes only public/<path>/ (index.html, sw3.js); with the old worker installed the path opens app3 under its own worker scoped to the path, offline and after a reload; the root is untouched; /api/ on the same address

Cloud copy on the page: turn on with a code shown once, I have a code, taken on opening, sent on leaving and at most every 90 s, Send now, the same record changed on two devices asked in Settings with the other kept, refused sends said, turn off saying what is lost
Service worker when served: page kept with cache reload, opens offline and after 3 s with no answer, a new build takes over and loads when the page goes to the background, /api/ never cached
Works as a plain file: first screen offers the made-up numbers, with a day box to step through the days
Ask, pure: a short summary of the engine's figures (refs, never ids, notes, shops or single spends), the reply checked into steps, a preview from the engine, Apply through act3, Undo all

Ask on the page: a question box, the line on what is sent and the exact summary, answers in plain words, proposed changes as ticked steps with before and after, Apply through ACT3 with Undo, the relay or the viewer's Claude
Reminders on the page: check-ins the day after pay and mid period, bills a chosen number of days before, a time, the calendar file made on the device, Google and Outlook links, nothing sent or saved
Reminders, pure: check-in days (after pay, mid period) and bill days from the engine's calendar, the calendar file, Google and Outlook links, words only
Walk 2: setup asks whether each bill due since the last pay has gone out yet (BI3); Home lists what may still go through (BI4a); a late or not seen pay is named by the day it lands (BI4b)
Walk 4: Plan shows an outstanding pay with its own amount; Receipts shows the typed note beside a statement row and search finds it
The real-page walk (walk 4 run A) as a gate: Mako's made-up shape from setup on 24 Nov to 15 Feb through the page, safe to spend and the bank at every step are the hand-worked figures
Setup, short (setup3): bank today, pay with a second income, cards with a close day or not sure, bills, the minimum; through build_book and the store
